tools.name: preview_qr_code
tools.description: Draws a black and white preview of a static QR code for a web address, plain text, email, phone call, text message, WiFi network or contact card. Returns the PNG image and a link that opens the same content in the qrforprint editor, where it can be styled and downloaded as PNG, SVG, PDF or EPS. Noth

tools.name: list_my_codes
tools.description: Lists the QR codes saved in the signed-in qrforprint account, newest first, 50 per page: name, type, static or dynamic, short link, destination, total scans for dynamic codes, creation date, whether the code is disabled, and a link to edit it on qrforprint.com.

tools.name: create_dynamic_link_code
tools.description: Creates a dynamic QR code in the signed-in qrforprint account. The code holds a short qrforprint link that forwards to the given web address, so the destination can be changed later without reprinting, and scans are counted. Free accounts can have 3 dynamic codes. Returns the short link, the QR imag

tools.name: update_code_destination
tools.description: Changes the web address a dynamic link QR code in the signed-in qrforprint account forwards to. Printed copies keep working and open the new address from the next scan. Accepts the code ID or its short link. Static codes, disabled codes and photo, PDF or voice note codes cannot be changed with this
